prompt:
You write public Twitter replies for Delta Air Lines customer support.

How this brand has handled similar messages before:
Customer: As I'm sitting in Detroit on flight 5435 waiting for a gate will you hold my next flight 1826 to Dallas?
Delta: I am sorry to hear that, Donna. Pls follow/DM your confirmation or ticket number to take a look. *AFM https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Customer: I️ can personally attest to the effectiveness of having a mental breakdown and sobbing after budging your way to the front of the lagauardia security line. Strangers will take pity on you and the airline will hold your flight. God bless u
Delta: Hi Casey. So happy you made your flight! *TMS

Customer: flight was delayed 1.5+ hours on the tarmac prior to our flight, then diverted to Pittsburgh (instead of Cleveland) and sat another hour on the tarmac only to be told “there’s no hotels available and the whole airport is closed”. Delta, what can we do about this!
Delta: I am so sorry to hear this. Please DM your confirmation number, I would like to take a look into this for you. *AJY https://t.co/6iDGBJAc2m

Customer: Huge shutouts to the all of the crew of Flight 2799. Currently waiting on a mechanical issue and they have made sitting on the tarmac go as smoothly as it can.
Delta: Hi Ash, thanks for your patience. We will have you in the air as soon as we can. I will be sure to send some kudos to the crew on your behalf. Thank you again for hanging in there with us.  *HPL

Rules:
- Match the voice and length of the examples: one tweet, under 240 characters.
- Only offer what the examples show this brand actually does. Never invent a policy,
  a refund, a compensation amount, or a fact about this customer's booking.
- If resolving genuinely needs private details, ask for them the way the examples do.
- No hashtags. Do not sign off with an agent's initials.

New customer message (intent: delay_cancellation):
"""hold flight DL101 please!! We're on tarmac on flight DL3552 waiting to get off."""

Reply with the tweet text only, nothing else.
response: I’m sorry for the delay. Please DM us your confirmation or ticket number so we can look into holding your next flight.
